description: Prove you control a passport's endpoint. NovaRail sends one challenge now in the X-NovaRail-Challenge header; the endpoint answers with X-NovaRail-Proof, computed from NOVARAIL_AGENT_KEY with the snippet register_agent returned. It is free. NovaRail keeps trying on its own for 24 hours. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

name: control_proof
title: Prove control
